# Locations & Battles

## Agnes {#agnes}

[Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. Agnes is a rural settlement featuring a main street, a depot, a [Methodist](../codex/factions.md#methodist) graveyard, and a [Presbyterian](../codex/factions.md#presbyterian) Church.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY P44](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0044), [v5 CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY P45](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0045), [v5 CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY P46](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0046), [v5 CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY P47](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0047), +15 more_

## Alder River {#alder-river}

Alder River is a location on St. Brendan's [Island](../codex/places.md#brendan-s-island) with a train station house and a modest hotel, situated eight miles from the [Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) farm across a road lined with farmsteads, fir forests, and apple orchards.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P12](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P14](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P15](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0015), +26 more_

> [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md) travels to the Alder River station expecting to collect a boy from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), only to find an unexpected orphan girl waiting for him instead. Unable to bring himself to explain the mistake, [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) takes her into his buggy for the drive home, pleasantly surprised to find her chatty company quite enjoyable.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER II. Obed Abernethy Is Surprised

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Obed Abernethy Is Surprised P4](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER II. Obed Abernethy Is Surprised P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027)_

## Aspen Path {#aspen-path}

Named by Isolde, the Aspen Path is a narrow, scenic track running through Mr. Bell's woods that forms part of a romantic route to the [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) school taken by [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Nell’s Confession P70](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0070), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P0](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P2](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0002), +17 more_

> Following the excitement of the school concert, routine resumes at [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) while [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde discuss turning thirteen and working on school essays along the Aspen Path. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) shares a dramatic story she wrote for Miss Thorne's assignment, inspiring the creation of a private story club with Isolde and other girls. When [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) discusses the club's creative endeavors with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) dismisses the story writing as foolish and harmful to her studies.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P3](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P13](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P22](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0022)_

## Avenue {#avenue}

The Avenue is a four- or five-hundred-yard stretch of roadway near [Stonebridge](../codex/places.md#stonebridge) that is completely covered by an arch of massive apple trees planted by an elderly farmer.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Obed Abernethy Is Surprised P40](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER II. Obed Abernethy Is Surprised P41](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0041), [v1 CHAPTER II. Obed Abernethy Is Surprised P42](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER II. ## Avery {#avery}

Avery is a scholarship, funded by a wealthy [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick) manufacturer, that provides two hundred and fifty dollars annually for four years of study at [Wexcombe College](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college) to the Regent’s graduate scoring highest in English and English Literature.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Regent’s Girl P20](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Regent’s Girl P21](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Regent’s Girl P22](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Regent’s Girl P23](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0023), +39 more_

## Bailey {#bailey}

The old Bailey property is a decaying, abandoned site with a ruined, weed-covered garden and dyke that has sat neglected for thirty years since its previous owners left, and it bears a local reputation for being haunted by the ghost of [Henry Warren](../character/henry-warren.md).

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXVIII. A FAST DAY P25](../source/v05-c28.md#nw-v05-c28-p0025), [v5 CHAPTER XXVIII. A FAST DAY P26](../source/v05-c28.md#nw-v05-c28-p0026), [v5 CHAPTER XXIX. A WEIRD TALE P0](../source/v05-c29.md#nw-v05-c29-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XXIX. A WEIRD TALE P1](../source/v05-c29.md#nw-v05-c29-p0001), +21 more_

## Beechwood {#beechwood}

Beechwood is the town residence of Isolde's [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md), featuring a library where [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) stayed during her week of entrance exams.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P5](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P6](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. **Associated with:** [Miss Pembroke](../character/miss-pembroke.md)

> Isolde informs [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) of an invitation from [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md) to visit her in town for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition). After [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) consents, Mr. [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) drives the girls to Beechwood, Aunt Lavinia's home, where [Miss Pembroke](../character/miss-pembroke.md) welcomes them warmly. The girls spend the week taking in the town's attractions, including attending the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition) and a concert.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Nell’s Life

## Boston {#boston}

Boston is a large, noisy city where [Jordan](../character/jordan.md) Gray worked during a winter, meeting [Dinah](../character/dinah-wren.md) Murray in a shop, and to which he returned after her death.

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P47](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0047), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P48](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0048), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P49](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0049), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P50](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0050), +8 more_

**Associated with:** [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md)

## Brendan’s Island {#brendan-s-island}

St. Brendan’s Island, also referred to as the Island, is a region near [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) where custom dictates that travelers bow to everyone they pass along the road.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P21](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P22](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER I. **Associated with:** [Belinda](../character/belinda.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md)

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) is day-dreaming while studying when Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) angrily confronts her about her cow escaping into his oat field again. After he leaves in a huff, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) locks the cow away and later discusses the incident and local gossip with [Aunt Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and Mrs. Agatha Sowerby over tea.
>
> — v2 · I An Irate Neighbor

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P28](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0028), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P38](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0038)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde begin canvassing for the [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), first visiting the Andrew sisters. While [Eliza](../character/eliza-pullen.md) bitterly refuses to donate, Catherine sneaks out to give them two quarters for the hall fund before they visit [Daniel](../character/daniel.md) Blair.
>
> — v2 · VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P12](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0012), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P16](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0016), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P30](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0030), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P31](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0031)_

## Brierley {#brierley}

Brierley is a rural home settlement featuring a local school, beech-woods, hollows filled with violets, and a branch train line connects to nearby [Delford](../codex/places.md#delford).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Regent’s Girl P5](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Regent’s Girl P6](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. **Associated with:** [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [Flossie Tulk](../character/flossie-tulk.md), [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md), [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md), [Robert Bell](../character/robert-bell.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Thorne](../character/thorne.md)

> In class, [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) teases [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about her red hair, prompting her to smash her slate over his head in anger. Mr. [Pidgeon](../character/pidgeon.md) punishes [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) by forcing her to stand at the front of the room and later making her sit beside Hugh, leading [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to declare that she will never return to school. Upon returning home, [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) seeks advice from [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), who recommends letting [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) rest at home until her temper subsides.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

> At a party hosted by [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) accepts a dare from [Flossie Tulk](../character/flossie-tulk.md) to walk across the kitchen roof's ridgepole. She slips and falls, breaking her ankle in the process. Mr. [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) carries her home to [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) spends the next seven weeks recovering in bed while friends, neighbors, and local figures visit her.
>

> In a letter to [Mabel](../character/mabel-colby.md), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) recounts amusing experiences and humorous remarks from her students while teaching school in Brierley. ## Camelot {#camelot}

St. Columbia is an educational institution where [Ezra](../character/ezra.md) [Hale](../character/ezra.md) studied theology.

## Convocation {#convocation}

Taking place following the conclusion of academic tests, Convocation was an event where students received their caps and diplomas from the president of [Wexcombe](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college).

_Sources: [v3 ch.B.A.’s P25](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0025), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P26](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0026), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P27](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0027), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P28](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0028), +11 more_

## Coombe Road {#coombe-road}

Coombe Road is a location with a train station, a mail route, and a school where [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) substitutes as a teacher for [Esther](../character/esther.md) Haythorne during July and August.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Wedding P15](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0015), [v3 ch.Wedding P16](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0016), [v3 ch.Wedding P17](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0017), [v3 ch.Wedding P18](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0018), +11 more_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) arrives at Coombe Road station, where she is picked up by Mrs. Amelia [Skinner](../character/skinner.md), who is temporarily driving the mail carriage for her new husband, [Thomas](../character/thomas-sowerby.md). During the drive to [Thora](../character/thora.md) Sweet's home, Mrs. [Skinner](../character/skinner.md) entertains [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) with stories about her suitors and marriage choices before dropping her off at [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside).

## Crystal Lake {#crystal-lake}

Crystal Lake is a marshy spot named by chance from a set of proposed titles written on birch bark and drawn from Nell's hat.

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P23](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0023), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P24](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0024), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P25](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0025), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P26](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0026), +7 more_

## Delford {#delford}

Delford is a nearby settlement with a school and shopping facilities, connected by road to [Stonebridge](../codex/places.md#stonebridge), [Pale Sands](../codex/places.md#pale-sands-hotel), and [Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md).

## East Welby {#east-welby}

East Welby is a place where [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) visited an exceedingly sick, far-off relation named Mary, whose local neighbors she was never on particularly good terms with.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P12](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0012), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P13](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0013), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P14](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0014), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), +14 more_

**Associated with:** [Baxter](../character/baxter.md)

## Eastmere {#eastmere}

Eastmere is a location where [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) spent three agreeable years working as a teacher.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREY SHUTTERS P0](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREY SHUTTERS P1](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREY SHUTTERS P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREY SHUTTERS P3](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0003), +15 more_

## Echo Cottage {#echo-cottage}

Echo Cottage is a beloved stone residence with a garden and honeysuckle trellis where Miss Rosalind resides, and which is intended to be kept intact for summer visits following her wedding.

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P73](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0073), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P74](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0074), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P75](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0075), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P76](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0076), +15 more_

**Associated with:** [Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md)

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns to teaching school, where [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) reports his classroom antics while [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) is terrified by [Mirabel](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) Cotton's stories of family ghosts. Later, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde take a wrong turn while walking through the autumn woods to a tea invitation and discover Echo Cottage, where its owner, Miss Rosalind [Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md), invites them to stay for tea.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P16](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0016), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049)_

> Miss Rosalind welcomes Isolde and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) for tea at Echo Cottage and explains her solitary life, imaginative habits, and why her young helper is called Belinda the Fourth. When [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) Stanhope's name is mentioned, Miss Rosalind asks if he is [Stephen](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) Stanhope's son before growing quiet and distant. As the girls walk away, they reflect on her loneliness and the meaning of names.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P84](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0084)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) walks to Echo Cottage to spend a cozy winter night with Miss Rosalind, who shares the story of her long-ago engagement to [Stephen Stanhope](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) and the prideful misunderstanding that separated them. A month later, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) brings Stephen's son, [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), to meet Miss Rosalind, and the two quickly bond during a pleasant visit.
>
> — v2 · XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010), [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P16](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0016), [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019), [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P27](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0027)_

> While picking strawberries for tea, [Belinda](../character/belinda.md) expresses concern to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) over Miss Rosalind's lingering melancholic mood and failing health. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) resolves to stay at Echo Cottage during her vacation to help lift Miss Rosalind's spirits. Afterwards, the group enjoys tea outside, and [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) sits with Miss Rosalind as she opens up to him about her imaginary dream-boy.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P49](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0049), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P51](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0051)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) writes a letter to [Stephen Stanhope](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) and sends it via the post office. Later that evening, [Stephen](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) arrives at Echo Cottage to see [Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md). To the delight of [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Belinda](../character/belinda.md), [Stephen](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) and [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) walk into the garden together, embracing as lovers.
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P45](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0045), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P59](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0059), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P70](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0070), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P71](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0071)_

Europe is an overseas travel destination planned for visits by Miss [Tabby](../character/tabby.md), [Maria](../character/maria.md) Linden, Miss Rosalind, and [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md).

## Fern Hollow {#fern-hollow}

Fern Hollow is a secluded valley located behind the maple grove at [Hollowmere](../codex/places.md#hollowmere), featuring an old abandoned house, moss-cushioned paths, wild cherry trees, and a tiny stream flowing from [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) village.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P69](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0069), [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P70](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0070), [v5 CHAPTER II. **Associated with:** [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md)

> Mary discusses her fear of damnation and beatings with [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) and [Grace](../character/grace.md) before being introduced to the [Carrows](../codex/factions.md#carrows) at Fern Hollow. Afterwards, the girls arrange for Mary to sleep in the parsonage garret room. Later that night, [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) comforts Mary in the garret, where Mary expresses her fears and jealousy before they reconcile and fall asleep.

Despite occasional arguments, Mary captivates the children with her stories, ghost tales, and unique tricks.

After learning Mrs. [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) blames [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) for getting Isolde drunk, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) visits [Pear Hill](../codex/places.md#pear-hill) to clear up the mistake but is rebuffed. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) then confronts Mrs. [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) herself to beg for forgiveness, but Mrs. [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) coldly turns her away.

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) wakes up at Grey Shutters and marvels at the bright June morning outside her window, though she laments that her stay will likely be brief. During breakfast and while helping with household chores, she talks incessantly to a sharp yet increasingly fascinated [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), even bestowing names like [Frost Maiden](../codex/places.md#frost-maiden) on the cherry tree and Bonny on the geranium. Afterwards, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) takes [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) in the buggy to [Pale Sands](../codex/places.md#pale-sands-hotel) to meet Mrs. [Tranter](../character/tranter.md) and settle Nell's return to [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), despite Obed's quiet desire to keep the girl.
>

> Mrs. Agatha Sowerby visits Grey Shutters and rudely mocks Nell's plain appearance and red hair. Enraged by the insult, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) flies into a violent temper and shouts at Mrs. Sowerby before storming off to her room. After Mrs. Sowerby leaves in offense, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) goes upstairs to lecture [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and demands that she apologize, though [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) stubbornly refuses.
>

> [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) reprimands [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) for wearing flowers on her hat to church, then takes her to [Pear Hill](../codex/places.md#pear-hill) where [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) meets [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md). The two young girls quickly bond and swear to be best friends forever before [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns home. Back at Grey Shutters, [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) gives [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) chocolates, and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) admits to him that she is growing fond of the girl.

> [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) accuses [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) of taking her missing amethyst brooch and locks her in her room after [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) insists she didn't touch it. Desperate to attend the upcoming picnic, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) eventually fabricates a confession about dropping the brooch into the lake, but [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) forbids her from going anyway. Later, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) discovers the brooch caught in her own lace shawl and confronts [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about her fake story.

## Mount Holly {#mount-holly}

Located in [Harborough](../codex/places.md#harborough), Mount Holly is the historic Lindsay family estate where [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) stayed for two weeks.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Speaks P50](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0050), [v3 ch.Speaks P51](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0051), [v3 ch.Speaks P52](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0052), [v3 ch.Speaks P53](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0053), +14 more_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) enjoys her stay at Mount Holly with [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md), [Hector](../character/hector.md), and [Orlando](../character/orlando.md) before visiting her childhood home in [Harborough](../codex/places.md#harborough). The current resident shows her the east room where she was born and gifts her a bundle of old letters written by her late parents. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) visits her parents' grave, reads the affectionate letters in her room, and feels deeply connected to them at last.

Portmaris is a coastal location featuring a harbor and inlet, an ancient cemetery named [Old St](../codex/places.md#old-st). John's, and commercial thoroughfares.

After searching without success, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) stumble upon a 'To Let' sign on Tabby's Place in Portmaris.

Seven Gulls is a coastal locality home to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), featuring a lighthouse situated on a red sandstone precipice overlooking the harbor, channel, and sea.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P74](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0074), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P75](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0075), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P76](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0076), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P77](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0077), +27 more_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) walks through a foggy night to visit [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md), but retreats upon seeing [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) weeping bitterly inside her home. Outside, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) encounters Captain Saul [Garrick](../character/uncle-saul.md) and [Rufus Vane](../character/rufus-vane.md), and Captain Saul walks her back home while discussing [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) and the nature of the foggy darkness.
>

> During a cold winter at Seven Gulls, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) spends time with [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) and Captain Saul, though she senses an underlying distance and resentment from [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) despite their friendship. After [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) reacts bitterly to news of Nell's upcoming child, she later gifts [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) a delicately handmade baby gown. Meanwhile, Captain Saul shares his written life log with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), who wishes a talented writer like [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) could turn his adventurous life into a book.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 17 A SEVEN GULLS WINTER

[Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) gives birth to a baby girl, whom she names [Joyce](../character/joyce.md), but the baby dies shortly after birth, leaving [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh devastated. The community grieves with them as [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) slowly recovers while mourning her loss.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK

> Miss Winifred and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) chat over the newspaper obituaries and past parish stories, including a story about an overzealous evangelist named [Fiske](../character/fiske.md). [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) mourns the death of her loyal old dog [Carlo](../character/carlo.md), refusing Nell's offer of a replacement for now. After spending [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh return to Seven Gulls, where Captain Saul shares news from [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) about his upcoming book publication.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) gives birth to a healthy baby boy, bringing deep comfort to her and Hugh after their earlier loss. Friends and family gather to admire the newborn, whom they decide to name [James Obed](../character/james-obed.md). Afterward, [Winifred](../character/winifred-tolley.md) tells [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) that [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) plans to visit Seven Gulls, bringing up hopes for Lorna's future.

## Seven Gulls Harbor {#seven-gulls-harbor}

Seven Gulls Harbor is a harbor featuring an ancient pier and wharf where the [Royal William](../codex/tech.md#royal-william) arrived sixty years prior.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P35](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0035), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P36](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0036), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P37](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0037), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P38](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0038), +7 more_

> Hugh and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) ride in a buggy toward their new house near Seven Gulls Harbor. Along the way, they admire the landscape, pass a gaudy neighbor's house, and spot a strikingly beautiful girl herding geese before arriving at their home.
>

Miss Winifred [Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md) arrives to pay a visit while sewing a baby gown, keeping [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and an eavesdropping Hugh entertained with her straightforward and opinionated commentary on neighbors, men, and church denominations.

Walking home together afterward, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh affectionately discuss Lorna's potential, their own happiness, and their shared home as they look forward to spring.

## Seven Gulls Point {#seven-gulls-point}

Seven Gulls Point is a coastal location featuring a lighthouse tended by Captain Saul, whose rotating light beam winks like a grand star and is visible from the harbor shore between it and [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. [Agnes](../codex/places.md#agnes).

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P14](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0014), [v4 CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P15](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P16](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0016), [v4 CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P17](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0017), +10 more_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), Hugh, and [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) walk to Seven Gulls Point lighthouse on New Year's Eve, catching a rare glimpse of Venus's shadow along the way. At the lighthouse, they gather with Captain Saul and [Ambrose Kerr](../character/ambrose.md), who entertains everyone with songs and dances a wild, exhilarating dance with [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md). As midnight strikes, Captain Saul opens the door to welcome the [New Year](../codex/places.md#new-year) and offers a hopeful toast to all present.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P3](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P21](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0021)_

Captain Saul comforts [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) over her grief regarding [Joyce](../character/joyce.md) and tells her the story of his long-lost love, [Margaret](../character/margaret.md), asking [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to remember her and pass on her story.
>

## Sowerby’s Hollow {#sowerby-s-hollow}

Sowerby’s Hollow is a hollow located where the main road in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) slopes into a small ravine crossed by a calm rivulet, and it is the site of Mrs. Agatha Sowerby's home.

> Mrs. Agatha Sowerby notices [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md) dressed up and leaving town in a buggy on a busy afternoon, sparking her curiosity. Later that evening, she visits [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) to discover the reason for his trip. [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) explains that [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) has gone to the train station to pick up an orphan boy from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) to help on their farm, leading [Agatha](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) to express her strong doubts and warnings.

## Tabby’s Place {#tabby-s-place}

Tabby’s Place is a home located on [Linden Avenue](../codex/places.md#linden-avenue), featuring an arched entrance, a small garden with a pine grove, and a living room filled with old prints, china cupboards, braided rugs, and china dogs.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Friend P23](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0023), [v3 ch.Friend P24](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0024), [v3 ch.Friend P25](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0025), [v3 ch.Friend P26](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0026), +11 more_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) visit Tabby's Place and successfully arrange to rent the cottage from Miss Tabby Linden and her niece [Maria](../character/maria.md) for the upcoming school year. Later that night, [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) visits their room and enthusiastically begs to join them as a housemate, to which [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) agree pending Mabel's consent.
>

Later in her room, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) weeps over the altered relationship while [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) points out her foolishness.

[Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) teases [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about her new romantic admirer, leaving [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to wonder if [Cyril](../character/cyril-lisle.md) is her true Prince [Charming](../character/charming.md).

The girls then drive away with the platter along Tory Road.

## Venus {#venus}

Venus is a magnificent, gilded night star that can approach her earthly sibling closely in the southwestern heavens, casting a delicate shadow on pale snow that is said to herald a life's greatest blessing within twelve months of being seen.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P55](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0055), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P0](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P1](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P2](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0002), +7 more_

## Victoria Island {#victoria-island}

Victoria Island is a grand, delightful island discovered by [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde further up the brook, featuring a pair of maple trees and completely encircled by the flowing water.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P6](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P7](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P8](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P9](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0009), +5 more_

> [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) questions [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about why she is leaving for college and brings up Mrs. Gammon's gossip about her wanting to catch a husband. After sending [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) to bed, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) walks down to Victoria Island to sit alone and lose herself in peaceful daydreams.
>
> — v3 · Chapter I The Shadow of Change

_Sources: [v3 ch.Change P45](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0045), [v3 ch.Change P49](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0049), [v3 ch.Change P60](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0060), [v3 ch.Change P61](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0061)_

## Wayside {#wayside}

"Wayside" is a small, white house with a moss-covered roof and a Virginia Creeper-draped porch, situated in a dip near a marsh and owned by Miss [Thora](../character/thora.md) Sweet.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Romance P11](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0011), [v3 ch.Romance P12](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0012), [v3 ch.Romance P13](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0013), [v3 ch.Romance P14](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0014), +9 more_

> In a letter to [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) describes settling into her new lodgings at Wayside with [Thora](../character/thora.md) Sweet in [Coombe Road](../codex/places.md#coombe-road). She details the house, Thora's quirks, and the local atmosphere, while reflecting on past romances she has witnessed or facilitated.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXI Nell to Cressida

_Sources: [v3 ch.Cressida P0](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0000), [v3 ch.Cressida P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001), [v3 ch.Cressida P5](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0005), [v3 ch.Cressida P9](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0009)_

> [Thora](../character/thora.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) attend a prayer meeting where they meet [John Fairlie](../character/john-fairlie.md), Thora's suitor, who walks them home. Later, John invites them to his home for tea to meet his invalid mother, where Mrs. Fairlie drops hints about John and Thora's future together while John looks deeply pained.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXII Tea with Mrs. Fairlie

_Sources: [v3 ch.Fairlie P2](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0002), [v3 ch.Fairlie P10](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0010), [v3 ch.Fairlie P16](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0016), [v3 ch.Fairlie P29](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0029)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receives an unexpected and awkward marriage proposal from her neighbor [Sam](../character/sam.md), which she rejects and later laughs about with [Thora](../character/thora.md). [Hector](../character/hector.md) Ward arrives at Wayside to inform [Thora](../character/thora.md) that John Fairlie's mother is dying, and [Thora](../character/thora.md) returns later to report her death. Following the funeral, [John Fairlie](../character/john-fairlie.md) finally proposes to [Thora](../character/thora.md) and explains that his late mother had secretly forced him to vow not to marry during her lifetime, after which [Thora](../character/thora.md) agrees to marry him.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXIV John Fairlie Speaks at Last

_Sources: [v3 ch.Last P12](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0012), [v3 ch.Last P25](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0025), [v3 ch.Last P36](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0036), [v3 ch.Last P40](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0040)_

## West Welby {#west-welby}

West Welby is a locale accessible by a road that runs near the Kimball family's place and through surrounding woods.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P8](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0008), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P9](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0009), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P10](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0010), +20 more_

## Wexcombe College {#wexcombe-college}

Wexcombe College is a higher education institution where students undertake four years of study, complete examinations, and receive diplomas during [Convocation](../codex/places.md#convocation).

_Sources: [v3 ch.B.A.’s P4](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0004), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P5](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0005), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P6](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0006), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P7](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0007), +31 more_

**Associated with:** [Carrow](../character/carrow.md), [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md), [Ezra](../character/ezra.md), [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Mabel Colby](../character/mabel-colby.md), [Margaret](../character/margaret.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Wilfred Mott](../character/wilfred-mott.md)

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and her friends reflect on their college experiences before taking their final exams and attending [Convocation](../codex/places.md#convocation). [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) chooses to wear Hugh's flowers and his gift over Cyril's, but after hearing a rumor about Hugh's engagement to [Rowena Calder](../character/rowena-calder.md), she angrily breaks the gift and refuses to dance with him at the graduation ball.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVII Full-fledged B.A.’s

_Sources: [v3 ch.B.A.’s P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P31](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0031), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P35](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0035), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P38](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0038)_

> [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) writes a letter to [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) describing her stay at Cousin Emily's boardinghouse in [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point). She recounts her health scares, introduces the eccentric older boarders, and shares her growing admiration and feelings for [Ezra](../character/ezra.md) [Hale](../character/ezra.md), an earnest young theology student.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXIV Enter Ezra

_Sources: [v3 ch.Ezra P1](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0001), [v3 ch.Ezra P2](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0002), [v3 ch.Ezra P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 ch.Ezra P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015)_

## Whispering Wood {#whispering-wood}

The Whispering Wood is a gloomy spruce grove located over the brook, which [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde imaginatively named and designated as a haunted forest for their own entertainment.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P16](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P17](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P18](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XX. ## White Lady {#white-lady}

The White Lady is a young, remarkably straight silver birch tree growing alongside a stream in [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow), named by [Edmund Carrow](../character/edmund-carrow.md).

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER III. THE HOLLOWMERE CHILDREN P0](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER III. THE HOLLOWMERE CHILDREN P1](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER III.
